title: Ancient demo
era: the Upper Palaeolithic in Ice Age Europe

characters.name: MAKER
characters.card: an Ice Age clothing maker. Knee-length sleeveless tunic of rough grey-brown hide with a ragged hem, a lighter tan hide apron, a twisted leather cord belt tied at the front, a small leather pouch on the character's own right hip, dark hide leg wraps and soft rounded hide shoes; a bone tool tucked into the belt.

characters.name: HUNTER
characters.card: an Ice Age hunter, the same height as MAKER. Long dark brown fur cape over a hide tunic, a bead necklace of small shells, hide leg wraps, soft hide boots; carries a long wooden spear in the character's own right hand.

characters.name: WOLF
characters.card: a grey wolf, shoulder height about half of MAKER's height, thick grey fur shown with a few tick marks, pale belly, bushy tail.

poses.sewing_seated: sitting cross-legged on the ground, sewing two pieces of hide together with a bone needle
poses.stretching_hide: pushing a large hide onto a wooden frame of lashed branches, one leg forward
poses.inspecting: holding up a piece of hide at arm's length and examining it closely
poses.carrying_bundle: walking with a bundle of folded hides in both arms
poses.walking_spear: walking with the spear held upright

locations.cave_mouth: the wide mouth of a limestone cave in winter, snow outside, a small fire inside on stone
locations.camp: an open camp on a cold grassy steppe, a hide-covered shelter, a drying rack, distant hills

note: EXAMPLE ONLY: confirm every garment, tool and animal against sources before using this cast in a real video.
